text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to do dance lessons
with Stay Gold, someone was already there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
Ahhh......

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~gh, you're welcome!!
It's only natural for fellow dancers to share!
Ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Just now, I said,
"Dance lessons? I'll let you have the spot!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And so, I said thank you.
Hahaha, body language, you know?

"Even so, it's amazing that you were able to react on the spot.
I didn't understand even a single millimeter of it
until it was explained to me."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just a difference in experience?
When you travel the world, you encounter people
you can't communicate with through words.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: At times like that, put your feelings into your movements and facial expressions.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're right. For example...
Showing goodwill in a jungle village by going,
"We come in peace~" or something...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dance is a universal language, after all♪
Fufun, I'd probably do the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When I was surrounded by thugs,
I intimidated them, like, 'You wanna go?!' and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! How thrilling...!
So that was how you tried to avoid a fight!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's not like I always solve
everything with dancing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, actions speak louder than words.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ I totally get it!
As fellow worldwide Umamusume,
we're definitely on the same wavelength!

I see. Listening closely, it really was quite an interesting story.
What I found especially intriguing was...
choice_data_list: The "Friendship" dance could be useful for Winning Lives too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a nice idea!
Let's give it a try right away!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, wanna go for it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, just like that!
Haha, you've got great rhythm as always, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whooooo!
This is friendship!
This is friendship!
choice_data_list: Somehow, just watching this is making me feel cheerful...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Right? Hey, you should dance too!
Ahaha ha ha!

"Carried away by the moment, I joined the dance circle!
Sharing the fun by letting out raw emotion might have
boosted Stay Gold's expressiveness... maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Cool", huh?
I see.
Maybe I could incorporate that into the choreography.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'd certainly love to master that as well.
That display of strength to keep bad luck away!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! Like this!?
Hey hey hey! Go on, over there!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
Back then, I think it was something like this...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how it is!
I feel like I'm getting the hang of this.
Thanks, Stego!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, I'm glad it was helpful.

A shiver runs down my spine as well.
Once again, I'm reminded of Stay Gold's unfathomable depths...!
